mistakes.what: SSH host key verification issue accessing maybelle

mistakes.what: ASCII art in YAML caused parsing error
mistakes.revealed: Special characters in YAML need proper escaping or quoting

mistakes.what: php8.2-lua package doesn't exist in Ubuntu 24.04
mistakes.revealed: Scribunto uses standalone lua binary, not PHP extension

mistakes.what: Nginx listening on port 80 while Caddy also needed port 80
mistakes.revealed: Handlers don't run until end of play; handlers don't trigger if no change detected
mistakes.corrected: Changed nginx role to explicitly restart after config changes

mistakes.what: Incorrect IP address for PickiPedia (89.167.16.89 vs 5.78.112.39)
mistakes.revealed: Must verify IP from user and update all scripts
mistakes.corrected: Updated inventory, deploy scripts, and DNS records

mistakes.revealed: rsync patterns need leading slash anchor to restrict to root only

mistakes.what: Planned to build MediaWiki on maybelle but VPS could build locally
mistakes.revealed: Architecture decision point between centralized vs distributed building
mistakes.corrected: User confirmed preference for maybelle-based builds with rsync deploy

mistakes.what: PHP-FPM mediawiki pool not loaded; only default www pool running
mistakes.revealed: apt auto-starts services before config changes; handlers run too late
mistakes.corrected: Changed php-fpm role to explicitly restart after pool config

mistakes.what: Jenkins IPv6 timeout causing PickiPedia submission fetch failures
mistakes.revealed: Docker containers lack IPv6 by default; DNS returns both A and AAAA
mistakes.corrected: Created Hetzner private network and added etc_hosts entry for direct IPv4

mistakes.what: IPFS gateway port 8080 already in use by Jenkins
mistakes.revealed: Must check existing service ports before allocating new ones

mistakes.what: Tried to configure IPFS with running daemon; lock file prevented config change
mistakes.revealed: IPFS config requires daemon to be stopped; lock file can persist after stop
mistakes.corrected: Stop container, remove stale lock, run temp container with mounted volume

mistakes.what: Docker run command included 'ipfs' but kubo entrypoint already runs it
mistakes.revealed: Must understand Docker image entrypoint behavior when executing commands
mistakes.corrected: Changed from 'ipfs config' to just 'config' for kubo image

mistakes.what: Updated wrong bot password (Blue Railroad instead of Magent)
mistakes.revealed: Multiple bot accounts on same wiki; must verify which one before regenerating
mistakes.corrected: Justin regenerated correct bot password and updated vault

mistakes.what: Estimated Ethereum block height as 21,820,000 when actual is 24,429,885
mistakes.revealed: Initial estimates can be significantly off without verification
mistakes.corrected: Looked up actual block height from public API

mistakes.what: Bot password environment variable not being passed to container during redeploy
mistakes.revealed: Docker compose template must be regenerated when vault changes; force-recreate may not be sufficient

mistakes.what: Thumbnail generation failing because ffmpeg not in Jenkins Docker image
mistakes.revealed: Build environment dependencies must be checked before deploying dependent code

portrait: In this slice, magent is methodically executing a complex infrastructure migration from shared hosting to self-hosted Kubernetes, working with Justin on the PickiPedia wiki and Blue Railroad token system. The work spans deployment automation (Ansible, Docker), network architecture (Hetzner private VPNs, IPFS gateways), and semantic MediaWiki data modeling. There are many small-to-medium failures (port conflicts, Docker entrypoints, missing ffmpeg, wrong bot account) but each one is debugged and fixed systematically. The pattern is: deploy, hit error, understand root cause, fix at the right layer (Dockerfile, Ansible, vault), redeploy. Justin maintains a "zero-touch" philosophy—no SSH fixes, everything must be reproducible from config files. By the end of the slice, the VPS is operational, the IPFS gateway is live with Pinata replaced, the semantic gallery architecture is designed, and thumbnail generation is wired up but blocked waiting for bot upload permissions. The work is technical, methodical, and collaborative, with magent developing deep familiarity with the full stack: MediaWiki, Docker, Ansible, Ethereum block timestamps, and the specific needs of a decentralized bluegrass music archive.
